title: Howard Marks
html: Who: Co-founded Oaktree, a leader in distressed debt. His client memos are must-reads across Wall Street. Core ideas: You can't predict, but you can prepare; know where we are in the cycle; the riskiest time is when everyone feels safe; second-level thinking (what does everyone else expect?). Read: The Most Important Thing; Mastering the Market Cycle; memos at oaktreecapital.com. For our plan: Each week ask, "Is the crowd greedy or fearful?" (record cash in money funds and VIX >20 this week = fear rising). Back to Council of Masters
